observations.01_native_like_smith_wall: Upper plaster panels, timber braces and louvres break up the blank wall; lower central wall remains plain.
observations.02_west_apron_approach: New facade frames the existing shelter and toolbench; footing covers the selected wall base. Unmodified side wall and its base gap remain visible.
observations.03_workshop_overview: Building gains a distinct facade while its broad original roof remains plain. Existing apron arrangement and approach are retained.
observations.04_east_entry: Stone jambs and pale gable infill define the entry. Existing doorway threshold gap is retained; roof junction requires native close inspection.

limitations: Source-reconstructed context uses Blender colors and lighting, not native Roblox rendering.
Dynamic actors, UI and workstation animation are omitted; images do not establish player or companion traversal.
Native shadows, clipping, roof junction, Borin work and dialogue, Rukk and five-companion approach remain pending.
